summary: Resolves the pit-crew setup inputs for a vehicle skin and instantiates the crew model. Computes the crew instance target as dword_8AC394 (vehicle-array base) plus the vehicle index stored at skin object +0x4898 (dword index 4646) scaled by stride 1060. Resolves a skin/path override string: for the player vehicle (this[0] == dword_7C54E8) it prefers dword_7CFE0C, otherwise falls back to the path at this[36] (offset 0x90) when non-empty, with byte_5EA438 as the final default. Ends by calling PitCrewInstanceSetup with the resolved target, path and path-storage pointer. Called by VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader (004DFCE0).

operations.description: Compute crew target v1 = dword_8AC394 + 1060 * vehicleIndex, where vehicleIndex = *((_DWORD *)*this + 4646) is read from skin object offset 0x4898.
Player-vehicle check: when *this == dword_7C54E8, candidate path v2 = dword_7CFE0C, defaulting to byte_5EA438 when dword_7CFE0C is null.
Load the path candidate v3 = this[36] (offset 0x90), falling back to byte_5EA438 when it is null.
Non-empty override check: when *v3 is non-zero, take the final path v2 = *v4 (value stored through this + 36), defaulting to byte_5EA438 when *v4 is null.
Call PitCrewInstanceSetup(v1, v2, (int)(this + 36), 0) to instantiate the pit crew with the computed target, resolved path and path-storage pointer.
